name: Patch kits
blurb: Planks cut to size, oakum and a pot of pitch: four kits to stop a leak at sea.

name: Mend kits
blurb: Canvas cut into patches, twine and spare line: three kits to mend torn rigging at sea.

name: Crates
blurb: A load of lumber knocked into four plain crates.

name: False-light rig
blurb: A lantern on a pole with colored glass, kerosene for a night's burning.

name: Repair stores
blurb: Lockers built in under the cabin sole: room for four more of each kit. Install it at a slipway.

name: Powder and shot
blurb: Scrap iron cast into ball and cut into chain and grape, made up in cartridges: a keg of ten charges, for any kind you fire.

name: Lockpicks
blurb: Spring steel filed into six picks and a tension wrench.

name: Crowbars
blurb: Two pry bars drawn out of bar iron on the anvil.

name: Improved carriages
blurb: Iron-shod carriages with better tackle: the guns reload a fifth faster. Install them at a slipway.

name: Barrels
blurb: Staves split and hooped into eight tight barrels.

name: Salt fish
blurb: Fresh fish split, salted down and packed in barrels: it keeps all winter.

name: Re-crate stolen goods
blurb: A load of hot goods unpacked and packed again in a plain crate: the company's marks are gone, though the theft is still remembered.

name: Untaxed whiskey
blurb: Wheat mashed with well water, run through the still and casked: four loads of whiskey no revenue man has seen. A batch takes a week.
